Honest signer state: on the Mac the bundle is unsigned_on_this_host — the private key lives on the signing node, and an unsigned bundle is always labelled unsigned. Ledger: /refutation-ledger — the history of being wrong, immutable and verifiable. "We kill our own bad ideas" is not a slogan; it is a file. Split integrity: practice/held-out salted split + denominator floor + held-out-stripped fuel writer — a benchmark that trains on its own eval is structurally impossible here. Substrate (the economics) Measurement runs on free tier: HF · Kaggle T4 · Groq · Ollama. No paid GPU in the measurement path — the moat cannot be undercut on cost. RunPod spot only for bounded training, $0.22–$1.39/hr, ~$5 caps, owner-gated. CSOAI Ltd · UK company 16939677 · Every published figure traces to a signed, verifiable record.
